title: Lutein by Scleral Iontophoresis in AMD
official: Lutein by Scleral Iontophoresis in Patients With Stage 3 Age-Related Macular Degeneration
summary: The objective of the clinical investigation is to evaluate the performance, safety and degree of tolerability resulting from the use of the iontophoresis medical device in adult subjects diagnosed with AMD stage 3 (AREDS classification) in one or both eyes.
